comments.title: PUT replaces the visit; a missing vetId means no vet
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — PUT replaces the visit; a missing vetId means no vet

**Not taken:** PATCH-like: absent keeps the vet, explicit null clears it

**Why:** Ticket item 2 makes "clear must stick" the priority, and full-replace PUT is the simplest rule that guarantees it; the only client, our edit form, always sends the field. Four reviewers flagged the omitted-field case, which pulls confidence down.

comments.title: Unknown vetId is a 404
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — Unknown vetId is a 404

**Not taken:** 400 naming vetId as the bad field

**Why:** Matches how unknown pet types are handled. A 400 is more correct HTTP, which is why this is close to a coin flip.

comments.title: Deleting a vet keeps their visits, with no vet
comments.anchor: ALTER TABLE visits ADD COLUMN vet_id INT REFERENCES vets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — Deleting a vet keeps their visits, with no vet

**Not taken:** refuse deleting a vet who has visits

**Why:** Ticket item 4 makes "no vet" a normal state, and before this change vet deletion always succeeded. Losing who attended is a real history loss, so a business owner could reasonably pick refusal.

comments.title: "No vet" is the wording for a visit without one
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.75 — "No vet" is the wording for a visit without one

**Not taken:** "—" or "Not assigned"

**Why:** Ticket item 4 rules out "Unknown" and blank; "No vet" says "has none" literally, and the same label serves as the combo placeholder.

comments.title: Seed gives a vet to some demo visits only

comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.65 — Seed gives a vet to some demo visits only

**Not taken:** leave every seeded visit without a vet

**Why:** The demo should show both states; ticket item 4 is about real legacy rows, not the demo dataset.

comments.title: MCP create_visit takes no vet; list_visits shows it
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — MCP create_visit takes no vet; list_visits shows it

**Not taken:** also add a vet parameter to create_visit

**Why:** "Everywhere" in the ticket covers displaying, which list_visits does; choosing a vet at booking stays a staff action in the UI.
